subtitulo: Five questions about the last minute, the season you name, and the eight openings on the card
introPt: A traveller spends fifteen minutes on the last morning instead of five, and leaves as someone expected back.
cenario: Three doors within two hundred metres, and a bus in fifty minutes.

dialogo.pt: Bless you! Have a good trip.

dialogo.es: Πάρε την κάρτα μου. Τηλεφώνησε πριν έρθεις.
dialogo.pt: Take my card. Ring before you come.
dialogo.tts: Πάρε την κάρτα μου. Τηλεφώνησε πριν έρθεις.

dialogo.pt: Until we meet again! Go well.

perguntas.pergunta: What are the three parts of a goodbye that actually lands?
opcoes: A tip, a handshake and a review
The person's name, the thing they did, and the season you are coming back
An apology, a compliment and a promise
A long thank-you speech
perguntas.explica: Generalised warmth evaporates on the way out of the door. A named dish and a named month stay in the building.

perguntas.pergunta: Πότε ξανάρχεσαι — how should you take that question?
opcoes: As a formula that wants no real answer
As a literal question, best answered with a season
As a hint that you have overstayed
As a sales pitch
perguntas.explica: It is usually meant literally, and an answer with a month in it is remembered. If you cannot promise one, ίσως του χρόνου is a respectable reply.

perguntas.pergunta: Why is autumn or spring a better answer than August?
opcoes: Flights are cancelled in August
The summer share of arrivals fell from 56 to 50 percent while spring and winter grew — the good weeks moved
Most places are closed in August
It is the cheapest month of the year
perguntas.explica: Arrivals reached 29.3 million in 2024; spring was up 21 percent and winter 16. The shoulder months are unhurried, open and much easier to talk in.

perguntas.pergunta: Which line means «until we meet again», said as a plan rather than a wish?
opcoes: Καλό ταξίδι
Να είστε καλά
Καλή αντάμωση
Χάρηκα πολύ
perguntas.explica: Καλό ταξίδι sends you off, να είστε καλά means be well, χάρηκα πολύ closes a first meeting — and καλή αντάμωση is the goodbye of someone who intends to return.

perguntas.pergunta: The card in your pocket holds eight openings. Which set is it?
opcoes: Numbers, days, colours and directions
Έχετε, μπορώ να, πού είναι, θα ήθελα, χωρίς, πόσο κάνει, ψάχνω, συγγνώμη
Eight complete sentences to memorise
The eight verbs that conjugate irregularly
perguntas.explica: None of the eight changes shape. You keep the opening and change only the noun after it — and συγγνώμη goes in front of any of them when you are stopping a stranger.
